item.description: Provisions include revisiting safety standards for mid-rise buildings, streamlining environmental reviews and adjusting multifamily loans.

item.title: Sitewire launches AI tools to streamline pre-construction risk review
item.description: Sitewire’s BudgetIQ and PermitIQ use AI to automate budget checks and permit research, reducing manual work for small residential builders.

item.title: REMAX Results acquires REMAX Unlimited in Florida expansion

item.title: CMLS unveils new 2026 board, names Nicole Jensen chair

item.title: CFPB’s ECOA proposal raises alarms over women’s ability to get a mortgage
item.description: The CFPB's proposed changes to ECOA rules could limit credit access for women, communities of color and rural residents.
